name: PSS Side Day Gdańsk 2026
information: PL: Zapraszamy na PSS Side Day Gdańsk 2026 — jednodniowe zawody organizowane przez Polskie Stowarzyszenie Speedcubingu, skupione na mniej popularnych konkurencjach. Czekają Was 3 próby FMC, Megaminx, 4x4x4 BLD, 5x5x5 BLD oraz aż trzy rundy 3x3x3 BLD. **Zawody nie należą do serii Gdańskiej Ligi Speedcubingu (GLS).** --- EN: You are invited to PSS Side Day Gdańsk 2026 — a one-day competition organized by the Polish Speedcubing Association, focused on less popular events. The competition features 3 attempts of FMC, Megaminx, 4x4x4 BLD, 5x5x5 BLD, and as many as three rounds of 3x3x3 BLD. **The competition is not part of the Gdańsk Speedcubing League (GLS).** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc1MTA3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a404262f688b4227ab529f8166f2da124179e591/logo-pss-wersja-transparentna%20(2).png =125x125)
